_doc: Settings › Connections. Status/login plumbing in scripts/connectors.sh (check/save/login/logout per id).

connectors.name: Claude Code
connectors.about: The claude CLI (sessions, voice escalation later).

connectors.name: GitHub
connectors.about: gh CLI login: the GitHub card + tab.

connectors.name: Spotify
connectors.about: spotify_player with your own developer app (developer.spotify.com, redirect http://127.0.0.1:8989/login).

connectors.name: Discord (discordo)
connectors.about: discordo keeps its token in the keyring; it asks on first run.

connectors.name: Mullvad VPN
connectors.about: The VPN tile and status glyph.

connectors.name: Proton Mail (Bridge)
connectors.about: Bridge must be signed in to Proton (CLI login), then the shell reads the inbox over local IMAP with Bridge's own username + password (Bridge › account › mailbox details).

connectors.name: Proton Calendar
connectors.about: Read-only share link (Proton Calendar › settings › share via link).

connectors.name: Docker
connectors.about: The Docker tab. Needs the daemon and the docker group.
connectors.manual: sudo systemctl enable --now docker && sudo usermod -aG docker $USER

connectors.name: Open-Meteo weather
connectors.about: No account; only your coordinates are sent.

connectors.name: lrclib lyrics
connectors.about: No account; sends artist / title / album.
